id: title:dmarchuk:answer billing limited push registrations with 429 and retry after

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a test for handling HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) responses and the Retry-After header from the push subscription service, supporting billing limit enforcement and service reliability.
review.reason: Adds a PushErrorType 'throttled_error' and a constant for the Retry-After header, and includes a test asserting the HTTP response status and headers when the push subscription service returns a 429 status. This supports billing limit enforcement and service reliability.
review.uncertainty: The actual implementation of the billing limit check and HTTP response construction is not demonstrated in this chunk, only the service, handler, and test. The tier is assigned based on the presence of the relevant error type, constant, and test, but the complete behavior is not verified.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the billing limit check or the HTTP response construction, only the service and handler. The billing limit rejection and Retry-After header are not demonstrated. No score.
